name: B10-0280/2026 (PfE) – Implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
part_text:
This is a non-binding resolution from a political group, not a law. It asks the European Commission to pause two articles of the 2024 Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive. Those articles make drug and cosmetics companies pay at least 80% of the cost of extra water cleaning to remove micropollutants. The group says this burden is too heavy and could push medicines off the market. It wants a new independent impact assessment and a proposal to amend the directive.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It asks the Commission to suspend Articles 9 and 10 and propose amendments.
- **Who it affects:** Pharmaceutical and cosmetics companies, water users, and patients relying on medicine supplies.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act; a court case on the same rules is pending.
